title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0505
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0505
Multiple Vulnerabilities in Google Chrome for Desktop
Original Issue Date:October   14, 2026
Severity Rating: CRITICAL
Software Affected
Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.79 for Linux
Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.79/.80 for Mac
Google Chrome prior to 155.0.8059.79/.80 for Windows
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in Google Chrome for Desktop which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, disclose sensitive information, gain elevated privileges, bypass security restrictions, or cause denial of service (DoS) conditions on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
All end user organizations and Individuals using the affected Google Chrome for Desktop.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of remote code execution, disruption of services, security restriction bypass, and sensitive information disclosure.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for unauthorized access, exposure of sensitive information, and compromise of the affected system.
Description
Google Chrome is a popular internet browser used for accessing information on the World Wide Web. It is designed for use on desktop systems including Windows, macOS and Linux.
These vulnerabilities exist in Google Chrome for Desktop due to security flaws affecting various browser components, including memory management, JavaScript processing, and other browser functionalities. A remote attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a specially crafted request to the targeted system.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, disclose sensitive information, gain elevated privileges, bypass security restrictions, or cause denial of service (DoS) conditions on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply appropriate updates as mentioned by the vendor:
https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/10/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01668083673.html
